items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    traffic_source,
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
            THEN sessions
            ELSE 0
        END) AS this_week_sessions,
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
                 AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
            THEN sessions
            ELSE 0
        END) AS last_week_sessions,
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
            THEN sessions
            ELSE 0
        END) - 
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
                 AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
            THEN sessions
            ELSE 0
        END) AS change_sessions,
    ((SUM(CASE
            WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
            THEN sessions
            ELSE 0
        END) - 
      SUM(CASE
            WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
                 AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
            THEN sessions
            ELSE 0
        END))
        ::numeric / NULLIF(
            SUM(CASE
                    WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
                         AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
                    THEN sessions
                    ELSE 0
                END), 0)) * 100.0 AS pct_change_sessions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date + 7
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY change_sessions DESC
LIMIT 1000;

items.question: 지난주 세션 100개 이상인 유입 소스·매체 중 전환율(%)이 가장 높은 3개는?
items.sql:
SELECT 
    traffic_source,
    traffic_medium,
    SUM(sessions) AS sessions,
    SUM(conversions) AS conversions,
    ROUND(SUM(conversions)::numeric * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions),0), 2) AS conversion_rate
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source, traffic_medium
HAVING SUM(sessions) >= 100
ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC
LIMIT 3;

items.question: 최근 28일 동안 요일별(ISO 요일 번호, 월=1) 하루 평균 세션 수는?
items.sql:
WITH daily_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        summary_date,
        SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
    FROM agg_user_session_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
      AND summary_date <  current_date
    GROUP BY summary_date
)
SELECT
    EXTRACT(isodow FROM summary_date) AS iso_weekday,
    ROUND(AVG(total_sessions)::numeric, 2) AS avg_sessions
FROM daily_sessions
GROUP BY iso_weekday
ORDER BY iso_weekday;

items.question: 최근 7일 기기 유형별 결제 전환율(%)을 알려줘. 결제(is_payment) 이벤트가 있었던 세션의 비율로 계산해줘
items.sql:
WITH total_sessions AS (
    SELECT device_type,
           COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS total_sessions
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= current_date - 7
      AND timestamp < current_date
    GROUP BY device_type
),
payment_sessions AS (
    SELECT device_type,
           COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS payment_sessions
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= current_date - 7
      AND timestamp < current_date
      AND event_name = 'is_payment'
    GROUP BY device_type
)
SELECT t.device_type,
       ROUND( COALESCE(p.payment_sessions::numeric, 0) / NULLIF(t.total_sessions, 0) * 100, 2) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM total_sessions t
LEFT JOIN payment_sessions p
       ON t.device_type = p.device_type
ORDER BY conversion_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 1000;

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 일평균 순 방문자 수를 비교해줘
items.reason: 전치 허용: 정답의 열을 행으로 반환
items.sql:
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT sum(daily_visitors) AS total_visitors
  FROM (
    SELECT summary_date, count(*) AS daily_visitors
    FROM agg_daily_users
    WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
      AND summary_date < current_date
    GROUP BY summary_date
  ) v
),
prev AS (
  SELECT sum(daily_visitors) AS total_visitors
  FROM (
    SELECT summary_date, count(*) AS daily_visitors
    FROM agg_daily_users
    WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
      AND summary_date < current_date - 7
    GROUP BY summary_date
  ) v
)
SELECT '최근 7일' AS period, (recent.total_visitors / 7.0) AS avg_visitors_per_day
FROM recent
UNION ALL
SELECT '그 전 7일', (prev.total_visitors / 7.0)
FROM prev;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수 변화를 보여줘
items.sql:
WITH last_week AS (
    SELECT
        event_name,
        SUM(event_count) AS last_count
    FROM agg_event_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
      AND summary_date <  date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    GROUP BY event_name
),
this_week AS (
    SELECT
        event_name,
        SUM(event_count) AS this_count
    FROM agg_event_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    GROUP BY event_name
),
compare AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(this_week.event_name, last_week.event_name) AS event_name,
        COALESCE(last_week.last_count, 0)            AS last_week_count,
        COALESCE(this_week.this_count, 0)           AS this_week_count,
        COALESCE(this_week.this_count, 0) -
        COALESCE(last_week.last_count, 0)           AS diff,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(last_week.last_count, 0) = 0
            THEN NULL
            ELSE
                (COALESCE(this_week.this_count, 0) -
                 COALESCE(last_week.last_count, 0))::numeric /
                NULLIF(COALESCE(last_week.last_count, 0), 0)::numeric * 100
        END                                         AS pct_change
    FROM this_week
    FULL OUTER JOIN last_week USING (event_name)
)
SELECT
    event_name,
    last_week_count,
    this_week_count,
    diff,
    pct_change
FROM compare
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 1000;

items.question: 지난주 신규 방문자 수와 재방문자 수는?
items.reason: 정답 2번째 컬럼과 값이 같은 컬럼이 없음
items.sql:
WITH all_visits AS (
  SELECT client_id, MIN(summary_date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM agg_daily_users
  GROUP BY client_id
),
last_week_clients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT client_id
  FROM agg_daily_users
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
    AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
),
week_range AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7 AS start_date,
         date_trunc('week', current_date)::date AS end_date
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN lv.first_visit_date >= wr.start_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_visitors,
  SUM(CASE WHEN lv.first_visit_date < wr.start_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returning_visitors
FROM last_week_clients c
JOIN all_visits lv ON lv.client_id = c.client_id
CROSS JOIN week_range wr;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 기기 유형별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH this_week AS (
  SELECT
    device_type,
    SUM(sessions) AS sessions_this
  FROM agg_user_session_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date + interval '7 days')::date
  GROUP BY device_type
),
last_week AS (
  SELECT
    device_type,
    SUM(sessions) AS sessions_last
  FROM agg_user_session_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - interval '7 days'
    AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
  GROUP BY device_type
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(t.device_type, l.device_type) AS device_type,
  COALESCE(t.sessions_this, 0) AS this_week_sessions,
  COALESCE(l.sessions_last, 0) AS last_week_sessions,
  (COALESCE(t.sessions_this, 0)::numeric - COALESCE(l.sessions_last, 0)::numeric)
    / NULLIF(COALESCE(l.sessions_last, 0)::numeric, 0) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM this_week t
FULL JOIN last_week l USING (device_type)
ORDER BY device_type;

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 nov_mega_sale 캠페인 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.reason: 전치 허용: 정답의 열을 행으로 반환
items.sql:
SELECT
  CASE period
    WHEN 'recent' THEN '최근 7일'
    ELSE '그전 7일'
  END AS period,
  sessions,
  sessions_diff
FROM (
  SELECT 'recent' AS period, SUM(sessions) AS sessions, NULL AS sessions_diff
  FROM agg_traffic_hourly
  WHERE traffic_campaign = 'nov_mega_sale'
    AND summary_date >= current_date - 7
    AND summary_date < current_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'previous' AS period, SUM(sessions) AS sessions,
    SUM(sessions) - (SELECT SUM(sessions) FROM agg_traffic_hourly
                     WHERE traffic_campaign = 'nov_mega_sale'
                       AND summary_date >= current_date - 7
                       AND summary_date < current_date) AS sessions_diff
  FROM agg_traffic_hourly
  WHERE traffic_campaign = 'nov_mega_sale'
    AND summary_date >= current_date - 14
    AND summary_date < current_date - 7
) AS t
ORDER BY period;

items.question: 최근 28일 주말(토·일)과 평일의 하루 평균 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_PART('dow', summary_date) IN (0, 6) THEN sessions ELSE 0 END)::numeric
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_PART('dow', summary_date) IN (0, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)  AS weekend_avg_sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_PART('dow', summary_date) NOT IN (0, 6) THEN sessions ELSE 0 END)::numeric
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_PART('dow', summary_date) NOT IN (0, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)  AS weekday_avg_sessions
FROM (
  SELECT summary_date, SUM(sessions) AS sessions
  FROM agg_traffic_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - INTERVAL '28 days'
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY summary_date
) sub;

items.question: 지난달과 이번 달의 일평균 페이지뷰를 비교해줘
items.reason: 전치 허용: 정답의 열을 행으로 반환
items.sql:
SELECT
  to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  (total_page_views::numeric / NULLIF(days, 0)) AS avg_page_views
FROM (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', summary_date)::date     AS month_start,
    SUM(page_views)                            AS total_page_views,
    COUNT(DISTINCT summary_date)               AS days
  FROM agg_page_daily
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date - INTERVAL '1 month'
    AND summary_date < date_trunc('month', current_date)::date + INTERVAL '1 month'
  GROUP BY month_start
) m
WHERE month_start IN (
      date_trunc('month', current_date)::date - INTERVAL '1 month',
      date_trunc('month', current_date)::date
    )
ORDER BY month_start;

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 전환 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT traffic_source, SUM(conversions) AS conv
  FROM agg_traffic_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY traffic_source
),
previous AS (
  SELECT traffic_source, SUM(conversions) AS conv
  FROM agg_traffic_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
    AND summary_date < current_date - 7
  GROUP BY traffic_source
)
SELECT COALESCE(r.traffic_source, p.traffic_source) AS traffic_source,
       COALESCE(r.conv, 0) AS conversions_recent,
       COALESCE(p.conv, 0) AS conversions_previous,
       COALESCE(r.conv, 0) - COALESCE(p.conv, 0) AS diff,
       CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(p.conv, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
           ELSE 100.0 * (COALESCE(r.conv, 0) - COALESCE(p.conv, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(p.conv, 0), 0)
       END AS pct_change
FROM recent r
FULL JOIN previous p USING (traffic_source)
ORDER BY conversions_recent DESC
LIMIT 1000;

items.question: 최근 14일 일별 모바일과 데스크톱 세션 수를 날짜별 한 행에 나란히 보여줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    summary_date AS 날짜,
    SUM(CASE WHEN device_type = 'mobile' THEN sessions ELSE 0 END) AS 모바일세션,
    SUM(CASE WHEN device_type = 'desktop' THEN sessions ELSE 0 END) AS 데스크탑세션
FROM
    agg_user_session_hourly
WHERE
    summary_date >= current_date - 14
    AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY
    summary_date
ORDER BY
    summary_date;

items.question: 지난주 세션 200개 이상인 유입 소스(traffic_source) 중 결제한 세션 비율(%)이 가장 높은 3개는?
items.reason: 정답 2번째 컬럼과 값이 같은 컬럼이 없음
items.sql:
SELECT
  traffic_source,
  SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions,
  SUM(conversions) AS total_conversions,
  ROUND(SUM(conversions)::numeric * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM
  agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE
  summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY
  traffic_source
HAVING
  SUM(sessions) >= 200
ORDER BY
  conversion_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3;
